text: {"name":"ble_connection_event_process","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Processes a BLE connection event using its link index and per-connection state while updating hardware control state.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v8":"link_context","v10":"connection_status","v11":"event_flags","v12":"event_flags_without_bit13","v13":"bit13_flag"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":29,"meaning":"BLE connection index used to select one of 32 per-connection contexts"},{"offset":30,"meaning":"Event flags; bit 13 is consumed and cleared"},{"offset":34,"meaning":"Per-connection status byte; 0xFF causes an early return"},{"offset":76,"meaning":"Pointer to a link context used for state checks"},{"offset":340,"meaning":"Per-connection state field used to select a hardware-handling path"}]}
